name: Bag Clip
description: One-piece bag clip printed flat and open: a thin flexure loop at one end acts as the hinge, and a hook lip on a post at the other end snaps over the tip of the upper arm. Flat or interlocking wavy jaws, optional raised text on the lower arm. Defaults give a 100 mm clip, 10 mm wide, with 6 mm arms.
source: inspired by Printables Bag Clip customizer and MasterFX's Bag Clip (Thingiverse 330151)
